prompt: Aerial fashion editorial scene shot from high above a pristine, vibrantly green golf course. The focus is on a pair of small golf carts traveling along a winding paved path, with neatly sculpted sand bunkers and putting greens surrounding them in elegant, organic curves. The bright white cart roofs and the surrounding deep green fairway create a bold graphic contrast when viewed from above. Inside each cart, a model dressed in minimalist, pastel or off-white Jacquemus-style resortwear is seated viewed from the top down, their posture relaxed and stylish. A few golf bags are mounted to the back of each cart, but their presence is subtle, keeping the attention on the sculptural landscape and the serene, curated lifestyle moment. The image is composed to be symmetrical and balanced, with negative space emphasizing the curves of the terrain. The overall color palette is saturated but refined lush greens, warm sand tones, and soft white details, giving the image an editorial sense of calm, luxury, and tongue-in-cheek sophistication.
